key_highlights: Brent oil tops $100 amid escalating US-Iran conflict, triggering ASX sell-off and renewed RBA rate hike speculation
ASX slides as big four banks (CBA, BHP, ANZ, NAB, WBC) fall on rising rate expectations; oil-driven inflation fears dominate
Iron ore under severe pressure ('drowning, not waving') weighing on BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX
RBA perceived as 'choosing recession' as business conditions hit weakest since pandemic; home buyer sentiment collapses
Gold and silver surge on safe-haven demand; WA gold juniors (Auric, Golden Dragon, Gateway) see strong activity
Austal jumps on $1.9b acquisition bid; Flagship expands copper exposure in Canada
Data centre energy demand strains NSW power grid, complicating Australia's energy transition
China signals loss of patience with Trump, adding geopolitical trade risk to commodity flows

sectors.trend: Iron ore in structural decline pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; offset by strong gold/silver safe-haven bid and rising copper. WA gold juniors (Auric, Golden Dragon, Gateway, Forrestania) see capital inflows. Flagship expands copper in Canada.
sectors.implications: Diversify away from iron ore exposure; gold and copper miners offer relative strength. Monitor iron ore contract prices for further downside.

sectors.trend: Big four banks (CBA.AX, ANZ.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX) fall as oil-driven inflation reignites rate hike bets. RBA seen as prioritising price stability over growth ('choosing recession'). Qantas $35M payout signals labour cost pressures.
sectors.implications: NIMs may benefit from higher rates but credit risk rises in recessionary backdrop. Home buyer sentiment collapse threatens mortgage growth. Defensive positioning warranted.

sectors.trend: Brent at $100+ on US-Iran conflict. Santos gas cartel 'breaking' as LNG pricing shifts. Data centre power demand strains NSW grid, creating structural energy demand. Coal-to-data-centre repurposing discussed.
sectors.implications: Santos (STO.AX) and Woodside (WDS.AX) benefit from gas repricing. Energy infrastructure and utilities gain from data centre demand. Oil importers face margin compression.

sectors.trend: Business conditions weakest since pandemic; home buyer sentiment at new lows. Retail and consumer discretionary under pressure. Chewy (US) shows resilience in pet/consumer staples.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WTW.AX, CSG.AX offer defensive income. Discretionary names (WOW.AX, IAG.AX) face headwinds. Monitor retail sales data closely.

sectors.trend: AI data centre buildout creating energy demand and construction activity. ATO vs Big Tech tax dispute signals regulatory risk. Anthropic AI safety concerns noted.
sectors.implications: Data centre REITs and infrastructure plays (e.g., VMC.AX, IAG.AX) benefit from capex cycle. Tech tax risk could affect listed software names.

sectors.trend: Austal $1.9b bid signals M&A activity in industrials. Hospital planning disputes and veterans funding gaps highlight public health strain. No major CSL.AX-specific news.
sectors.implications: Austal (AUS.AX) bid creates near-term catalyst. CSL.AX remains defensive anchor. Public health underfunding may create private sector opportunities.

key_themes: Oil shock at $100+ driving inflation fears and rate hike repricing across ASX
Iron ore structural decline vs. gold/copper safe-haven rotation
RBA in recessionary mode; business and housing sentiment at multi-year lows
Geopolitical risk (US-Iran, China-US) elevating volatility premium
Data centre energy demand reshaping Australian power and infrastructure landscape
WA gold junior exploration activity at elevated levels

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil price sustained above $100 / Middle East escalation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; favour gold and domestic energy producers; reduce oil-importing consumer names

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA forced into further rate hikes amid recession
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration in bonds; favour floating-rate and dividend-paying equities; avoid rate-sensitive REITs
Underweight BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold and copper miners

risk_assessment.risk_factor: US midterms and Trump policy volatility spilling into global markets
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain cash buffers; diversify into non-US-listed assets; monitor AUD/USD for carry trade unwinds

risk_assessment.risk_factor: NSW power supply shortfall from data centre demand
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor AEMO data; favour energy infrastructure and generation names; watch for government intervention

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and silver miners on safe-haven bid and WA exploration momentum
opportunities.rationale: Gold/silver at elevated levels on geopolitical risk; WA juniors (Auric, Golden Dragon, Gateway) showing high-grade hits and capital raises

opportunities.recommendation: Add domestic energy and gas names on $100 oil and Santos cartel break
opportunities.rationale: Santos gas repricing and LNG demand support STO.AX; data centre power demand creates structural tailwind for generators

opportunities.recommendation: Position in Austal on $1.9b bid catalyst
opportunities.rationale: Acquisition bid provides near-term price support and strategic value re-rating for industrials

opportunities.recommendation: Copper exposure via Flagship and majors on supply tightness
opportunities.rationale: Copper 'red metal soars' on energy transition demand; Flagship expanding Canadian stakes

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore-heavy mining exposure; rotate to gold/copper
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore 'drowning' on China demand weakness; structural overhang on BHP, RIO, FMG earnings

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim rate-sensitive REITs and consumer discretionary; favour dividend payers
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA rate hike risk and collapsing home buyer sentiment pressure REIT valuations and discretionary spend

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain 10-15% cash allocation; hedge AUD/USD downside
defensive_moves.rationale: Geopolitical volatility (US-Iran, China) and US midterms elevate tail risk; AUD vulnerable to risk-off flows

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 (^AXJO) faces downward pressure from $100 oil, rate hike repricing, and iron ore weakness. Expect 3-5% near-term drawdown risk. Banks and miners lead declines. Gold miners and energy names provide relative outperformance. Volatility elevated on Middle East headlines.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautious. RBA recessionary path and weak business conditions cap earnings growth. Structural shifts in iron ore (China) and energy (data centres) create sector rotation opportunities. Gold and copper remain structurally supported. Recovery contingent on Middle East de-escalation and China stimulus.

Australian CPI and retail sales print
US midterm election outcomes and policy shifts
Santos LNG pricing and gas market dynamics
watch_list: RBA cash rate and forward guidance
AEMO NSW power demand and supply alerts
China trade policy and US-China relations
Q3 earnings season (banks, miners) starting October
